method.initial_order: Eight actual owner formation commands on the first sampled logic tick; no army flow field can build during stationary warmup.

scenarios.combat: Opposing nearby formations attack-move into four lanes; HP multiplier maintains the load.
scenarios.march: Own-side cross-lane movement to distant opposite-z goals.
scenarios.detour: Opposite-side long goals across the authored map, including real static obstacles; occasional incidental defensive shots are retained.

method.cold_response: Forty representatives, one of each of five military types per owner; at least 0.15m observed displacement from command-time position.
method.steady_reverse_response: Prepared but not run. March-only second group order reverses toward original area; response requires movement toward the new slot and reversal relative to the old heading, avoiding a false response from unchanged previous motion.
method.movement_counter: native_move_calls counts calls, not collisions; last slide-contact monitor is not cumulative collision or proof of nonpenetration.
method.scene_callback_timer: Priority markers around SceneTree physics callbacks exclude native navigation/physics work outside that interval. Not the complete authoritative step.
method.root_render_timers: Native root viewport CPU/GPU render times, plus frame setup CPU separately. Rendering timings exclude gameplay CPU and update-once portrait SubViewports. Zero means unavailable.
method.engine_time_monitors: Godot 4.6.3 TIME_* are roughly one-second published window MAX caches, read once per second. NAV includes map sync/step and RVO callback dispatch, including body movement. PHYSICS includes NAV; PROCESS includes render-frame scripts/deferred/RenderingServer sync/draw. Different maxima need not occur on the same step; never subtract or treat them as per-step P95.
method.background_control: Initial exploration preserves the active user game/editor and only records start/end context. Clean ABBA adds identical roughly two-second read-only process inventory; observed external validation or process-set changes invalidate the run. Short activities between inventories can be missed; unrelated operating-system activity is not fully controlled.
method.CIM_cost: Reported query wall time is monitoring overhead, not automatically game CPU; all clean ABBA runs use the same observer.
method.benchmark_instrumentation: Unwrapped headline packages retain sparse event counters and SceneTree probes. Later allskin1 also increments one movement callback integer. The 17-entry timing-wrapper package is separate, even when its switch is off.

nesting: With RVO enabled, unit.velocity is a native navigation callback outside the SceneTree unit physics entry; with RVO disabled it becomes a child of unit.physics.
Unit.release contains explicit visual release-pose sampling.
Cursor.process contains Game.entity_at when an actual hover query happens.
scope_limitations: Inclusive scopes are not additive self-time.
Game.entity_at had zero calls in the unfocused test window; this says nothing about its interactive hover cost.
Native automatic AnimationPlayer, transform propagation and RenderingServer traversal remain outside many script entry timers.
End-snapshot max is the whole-sample maximum; subtracting maxima cannot yield steady max.
Native move_and_slide-only scope has been prepared for a future diagnostic package, but was not part of these runs.

clean_full_model_abba.conclusion: Node and frame-setup cost declined, but full-frame FPS did not show a reliable net gain. Runs vary substantially; these descriptive averages are not a stable slowdown percentage or a statistically proven effect.
investigation_hypotheses: Independent Skeleton skin instances may change automatic instancing/batching.
Merged geometry may change LOD or culling granularity.
Per-render bone interpolation and native modifier backup/restore/skin upload can replace the removed node-update cost.

excluded_performance_comparisons.reason: Background game/editor changed; independent collision verification overlapped the on run. Cannot infer timer overhead from FPS difference.

reporting_rules: Do not attribute changes across different PCKs/time windows solely to a single implementation change.
Exploration ablations change visuals or movement and are not shippable quality-preserving optimizations.
Stable observed 30 TPS does not imply low command latency or stable 60 FPS.
No complete native-authority-step P95 is available from callback probes plus cached window maxima.
